name: Seafrigo
verdict: Chaired by holding company Seafrigo Investissements (president Eric Barbe). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Le Havre cold-chain logistics group created by Eric Barbe more than 40 years ago; its companies are chaired by the holding company Seafrigo Investissements. Credit Mutuel Equity and BNP Paribas Developpement sit on its supervisory board; no state or state fund appears in the chain, so proposed none. Front-of-shirt principal partner from 2026-27 (previously on the shirts 2017-2020).
